name: base
description: The harness repo itself, layer 0 under every overlay (see docs/overlay.md)

setup.description: termaid, the Mermaid-to-terminal renderer, on PATH for every agent (the Claude Code plugin is enabled in base/settings/claude.json)
setup.run: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv tool install termaid==0.12.0; else pipx install termaid==0.12.0; fi
setup.manual: Install uv (or pipx), then run 'uv tool install termaid==0.12.0'.
